profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Leidos | Cyber Security, Software Development Security
profile.summary: As a software engineer at Leidos, I apply my cyber security expertise to develop and maintain 7 environments up-to-date throughout the software development lifecycle. I have over two years of experience in this role, where I have contributed to various projects involving data protection, threat analysis, and incident response. Prior to joining Leidos, I worked as a tech II at Juern Technology, where I gained valuable experience in software development and testing. I also have a background in sales, having worked as an associate sales representative at Orangetheory Fitness for over two years. I hold a degree in cyber analytics from The University of Texas at San Antonio, which has equipped me with the skills and knowledge to excel in the field of cyber security. I am passionate about staying updated with the latest trends and technologies in the industry, and I am always eager to learn new skills and take on new challenges.
